summary: Pharming Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 11, 2026 press release announcing FDA approval of a supplemental New Drug Application for Joenja (leniolisib) 40 mg and 50 mg twice-daily dosing in children aged 4 to 11 years weighing at least 27 kg with APDS. The filing is a routine product/regulatory milestone disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, ownership stakes, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are described. The newly approved doses are expected to be available in the U.S. in October through Pharming's specialty distribution network.
